summary: Prepared Session-2 English study materials in namnx-vn/english-kyna. First created Session-2/note.md for LC1 (2) 'How many people are there in your family?' with vocabulary, core grammar, look-like vs be-like, personal-answer templates, dialogues, common mistakes, drills, and a 15-minute pre-class plan (commit 7d5cbd5190a4e6906d3995e95bbedad00ddb24c7). Then created Session-2/note-2.md for festival speaking practice, centered on Tet/Lunar New Year but reusable for other festivals, including 30/60/90-second model answers, vocabulary/collocations, Q&A, common mistakes, connectors, pronunciation, 5W1H recovery strategy, challenge questions, and a keyword-only speaking card (commit 77d0243a5623e4730805d5c4863122784ac1a3a0).
